decisions.reason: As a platform-fitting sensor module it still supports the firm's core sensing business, though its age and dependence on specific sensor components make a refresh or withdrawal somewhat more likely than at launch.
Voltage measurement is a basic function in the modular system, so this replacement generation is likely to stay available unless a newer hardware revision is introduced soon.
The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software connectivity feature that broadens integration options, which makes it attractive to retain.
A CAN bus interface remains well aligned with German automation and embedded use cases, although an interface module can still be superseded by an updated version.
